record: possession v2.12 candidate, development stage: touch / control-change features (possession/touch.py) added to the stage-1 models; leave-one-match-out over the four DFL training matches
status: development numbers only: not a test, not a selection, not a competition score; nothing released or frozen changed

data.source: DFL/Sportec open data prepared-v1 (CC-BY 4.0), provider BallStatus/BallPossession labels
data.seed_note: seeds 9001-9008 were checked against earlier plan/results files (no earlier use as corruption seeds found); degrade draws its corruption parameters from the seed alone, so seeds 1-3 give the same three parameter draws in every match (also those of the training rows) and 9001-9008 give eight new draws

protocol.folds: leave one of the four matches out; stage-1 models trained on the other three (seeds 1-3, every 6th frame from seed % 6, H/A/D frames, both team views) with possession-v2-config.json hyperparameters
protocol.stage1_only: symmetrised stage-1 probabilities decoded directly with the frozen decoder (no stacking)
protocol.stacked: second stage trained on nested out-of-fold stage-1 probabilities (pair models on the two other training matches), as possession.train.stack_rows inside each outer fold; held-out copies use the stage-1 models of the outer fold
protocol.scoring: possession.evaluate.score (organisers metric, unchanged); short-possession recall = ground-truth H/A spells shorter than 50 frames matched one-to-one at IoU >= 0.3 (official_metrics.matched_gt_flags), pooled over the copies of a match; overall = mean over the four matches
protocol.models: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier predict_proba (not exported numpy trees)

touch_feature_seconds_per_call.note: one call = one corrupted copy (about 137k frames, 25 fps), one team view; both views = two calls; 2 CPUs, Python 3.13

variant_state_lookback_1s_stage1_only.what: touch columns with possession.touch.STATE_CAP_S = 1.0 (event-state columns look back at most 1 s), stage 1 only, same protocol (ablation_cap1.py); compared with the same base rows

short_spell_probability_check_stage1.note: stage-1 probabilities of the leave-one-match-out models on held-out development copies; reporting only

detector_sanity_check_J03WOH.note: development match only; sanity check of the detector, not a selection or accuracy claim
